multi_entity_note: Two separate patients (a 65-year-old woman and a 43-year-old man) with neurocysticercosis; first patient taken as the subject.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: First patient was diagnosed with vesicular stage of parenchymal neurocysticercosis; the second patient's diagnosis belongs to a different entity.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: Albendazole is the first anthelmintic given for the first patient's neurocysticercosis; carbamazepine is anti-seizure symptomatic treatment and levetiracetam was not given to her.
